name: Harlan Bagley
summary: In Stormwind's Trade District, Harlan Bagley keeps the Lionheart Armory stocked for customers. His shop stands on the district's northern side, serving citizens and visiting adventurers.

sections.title: The Lionheart Armory
sections.body: Harlan Bagley keeps the Lionheart Armory on the northern side of Stormwind's Trade District. He tends the stock and sells defensive gear from behind the counter. Trade and regional couriers bring supplies to the shop. The capital faces distant border conflicts and shortages.

faq.answer: Harlan Bagley runs the Lionheart Armory, an equipment shop in Stormwind City's Trade District. He is a human shopkeeper and tradesman.

faq.q: Where can I find Harlan Bagley?
faq.answer: You can find Harlan Bagley inside the Lionheart Armory, north of the central square in Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: What role does he play in Stormwind's commerce?
faq.answer: Harlan Bagley supplies armor and gear in the kingdom's capital. He sometimes hires adventurers to carry deliveries and secure supply shipments for his armory.

angles.text: As an Alliance merchant, Harlan Bagley helps supply the kingdom's capital with gear and goods. Threats across the surrounding territories put regular supply lines at risk.
